name: CareMessage
long_description:
CareMessage is a social enterprise and the largest patient engagement platform for low-income populations in the United States. We deliver personalized health education and care coordination through text messaging — reaching patients where they already are, in the language they speak, at the moments that matter most. Unlike technology built for large health systems and adapted down, CareMessage is designed from the ground up for organizations serving low-income, historically marginalized communities.

Founded in 2012, CareMessage has now engaged more than 22 million people across 45 states, partnering with Federally Qualified Health Centers, Free and Charitable Clinics, and Tribal Health Organizations to produce measurable improvements in health equity — and we publish the evidence to prove it. As a nationally-recognized social enterprise we reinvest revenue into impact. We believe driving profit and purpose are not trade-offs, they are the same strategy.

CareMessage has been recognized by TIME 100 Most Influential Company for Impact in Equality, Inc. Best in Business for Social Good, and recognized at the World Economic Forum for Social Entrepreneurship. Learn more about our work at: www.caremessage.org/impact

Most medicines being launched are missing their revenue potential by a large margin due to messy pharma data causing expensive inefficiencies. When preparing a drug launch, pharmaceutical manufacturers have to choose between three options:

* **Manual research:** time-consuming, human errors, language barriers
* **Databases:** $300k / year, poor data quality, limited scope
* **Consulting:** $300k / project, answers in weeks, data snapshots

# **Solution:**

* Cellbyte consists of 3 main layers:
  * **High-quality data:** comprehensive, globally interconnected, up-to-date
  * **Analytics:** instant due to integrated databases, personalized to each user
  * **Workflows:** built on deep user understanding, human-in-the-loop-interactions, consulting-level outputs
* Cellbyte’s AI workforce replaces Legacy Providers
* We’re live in **12 key markets,** adding new ones every week

# **Who we are:**

The three co-founders have known and worked with each other for many years: Daniel brings 5+ years of industry experience from his previous job at leading global Life Sciences consultancy Simon-Kucher. Felix has sold $3m+ ACV enterprise deals to customers like H&M for his previous YC startup. Samuel holds an MSc in Information Systems from TUM, and has built enterprise AI applications from scratch as ML Engineer at Celonis.

launches.tagline: Mantys helps SaaS companies calculate and forecast their ARR accurately in real time without using multiple spreadsheets.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We are excited to Launch [Mantys](https://mantys-new-d3fdb94a4d5f489b27ad571898cf.webflow.io/#top) to all of you!

Mantys helps SaaS startups get **real-time visibility of their ARR Cycle**. If you struggle to know what your contracted, live and realised ARR are at given point of time or need to go through a lot of manual effort to reach there, we can help you.

**Problem:**

As companies grow, revenue is not just revenue, it is Contracted ARR, Live ARR, Realised ARR, Churn, expansion, etc. and it becomes increasingly difficult to keep a track of them due to:

* **Data sitting in disparate locations:** Contracted ARR sits in CRM(Salesforce/Hubspot), Billed ARR sits in a billing software(Stripe, Chargebee), Churn sits in CS software(Gainsight) or Excel sheets, so on and so forth.
* **Most of the tracking ends up happening in Google/Excel sheets** which leads to dependency on individuals, high chance of errors and inability to handle multi-dimensional data
* **Difficult to forecast complex business models:** SaaS has matured and there are complex pricing models like usage based, hybrid emerging which makes customer level forecasting even more difficult.

As a result, founders/CFOs are not able to answer fundamental questions like what their ARR is, how much is actually realised, what is the onboarding cycle, how will it impact cash flow etc. at any given point of time leading to governance issues and lack of actionable insights. **It takes them 5-7 days every month to just compute revenue metrics.**

![Twitter 上的Chetan Puttagunta："There's ARR and then there's ARR  https://t.co/XMKKkooAsM" / Twitter](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/E34eGfvUUAADQ6C.jpg)

**The solution**

Mantys helps SaaS companies calculate and forecast their ARR accurately in real time without using multiple spreadsheets. For example, NextBillion uses Mantys to pull data from HubSpot and Chargebee and create real-time views of their Contracted ARR, Billed ARR, Churn, and forecasted ARR.

We enable them to:

* **Establish a single source of truth and automate processes:** Integrate with CRM, Accounting and Billing software to get real time visibility of your Contracted ARR, Billed ARR, Realised ARR, Unearned ARR, Expansion, Contraction, Churn, etc., broken down at customer & cohort level and use the data cleaning layer to reduce 80% of manual effort
* **Get actionable insights and take corrective action faster:** Know the exact cycle between Contracted to Billed to Realised and reasons for discrepancies for different dimensions like time period, region, industry, etc,. and take actions preemptively to avoid accidents
* **Simulate different what-if scenarios in minutes and forecast:** Build different scenarios to see how Bookings will translate into billing and cash flow and forecast at a customer/cohort level taking into consideration both revenue and usage data

**We know every business is complex and has it nuances. We have however, solved this problem for multiple Series A+ SaaS companies like MoEngage, Locus, etc. and have identified patterns for data cleaning and transformation across businesses. And we know how to handle them.**

* Recording Unbilled or unearned entries? Just enter on the system
* Usage based revenue? Integrate your usage data
* Don’t have a common identifier across systems? We can handle it.
* Multiple entity or currency issues? Don’t worry, we will convert it.

And we provide best-in-class templates which help SaaS startups get up and running in days with very minimal effort involved from their end.

**Our ask:**

* Have trouble figuring out your ARR lifecycle? Schedule time to chat here: <https://calendly.com/kriti-25/kritiarora_mantys>
* If you know any growth stage SaaS company who might be a fit, please introduce us.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

[Shasta Health](https://www.shasta.health/)‘s AI Platform provides muscle and joint pain relief **from home** at **¼ the cost** of traditional physical therapy. We combine computer-vision based care programs with expert physical therapists to deliver personalized care at scale. For providers, our platform automates patient acquisition, documentation and billing so they earn **3x more** than at a big clinic.

**If you are in CA, **[**sign up for an appointment today**](https://beta.shasta.health/patient/onboarding)**.**

### The Problem

We’ve talked to hundreds of PTs over the last few months who are burned out and looking to leave their profession. Existing digital MSK solutions are not personalized and only accessible through employer plans.

1. Physical therapists (PTs) only keep **25%** of the revenue they generate for their clinics. To earn enough money, they have to see more than 20 patients per day, spending **less than 15 minutes** with each one.
2. This leads to low patient satisfaction. Patients waste **5 hours** of time in the clinic and spend **$90** in co-pays in a typical week. **Only 30%** actually finish their full plan of care with the top complaint being lack of time and motivation.
3. Low adherence means the only alternatives are turning to opioids or surgery. This drives over **$600 billion** in annual healthcare spend on MSK conditions.

# 

### The Solution

Shasta Health provides **integrated** muscle and joint pain relief **at home**, combining expert care from PTs with AI tools to improve care plan adherence. Here is what happens when you come to Shasta Health:

1. You fill out a secure intake powered by an language model + computer-vision with your symptoms. We use this to match you with the right physical therapist and automatically generate documentation on the backend.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73766&key=user_uploads/896902/35c9bea3-c7b1-4858-afe9-87f633478f29)

2. You meet with your physical therapist in an hour-long 1:1 or group session. The PT already knows your history and evaluates you over video using our computer-vision based tools. They also teach you exercises to relieve the pain.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73766&key=user_uploads/1247241/a5af27c5-eb8c-4d20-82a1-8f52ae82d6f4)

3. After the appointment, we generate a personalized care plan based on the provider’s notes. We track your progress daily and provide real-time feedback using computer-vision during the exercises

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73766&key=user_uploads/896902/f83d300d-8a20-43b5-84d7-df41edbeeb93)


# 

### Who are we?

We’ve been friends and working together for over a decade - starting with a middle school robotics team in Pransu’s garage in Cupertino. We are advised by Dr. Ayoosh Pareek (Orthopedic Surgeon at Hospital for Special Surgery) and Dr. Laurel Mines (PT, DPT, Owner of Bay Laurel Athletics).

Srinjoy was previously a Senior Engineer at Microsoft, where he led computer-vision projects on the HoloLens AR headset for healthcare companies. Pransu built medical billing software at Athelas (YC16), led an engineering team at Cockroach Labs, and brings research experience in telehealth privacy from UC Berkeley.

We reconnected after Srinjoy moved back to the Bay Area to take care of a family member with a critical medical condition. He spent most of last year in numerous PT appointments and grew frustrated with the broken system. We teamed up and started Shasta Health to improve the delivery of hybrid care for MSK conditions.

# 

# **Asks**

1. Do you have any muscle or joint pain? Sign up for an 1:1 or group session with an expert PT to try out the experience for yourself (no referral required). We’ve run several successful group sessions with YC founders already. [Sign up here](https://beta.shasta.health/patient/onboarding)
2. Do you have any contacts at health systems / hospitals / payers? We would appreciate any intros as we try to scale up our patient acquisition channels (email [founders@shasta.health](mailto:founders@shasta.health))
3. Do you know any physical therapists that are interested in contract positions or going independent? We would love to talk to them as we scale our provider network

launches.tagline: Where healthcare operations become intelligent.
launches.body:
Clinics that rely on point solutions and disconnected tools create missed opportunities, fragmented patient experiences, and endless admin work.

**Decoda Health** **is the operating system for modern elective-care clinics.** Our AI agents answer calls, take notes, keep calendars full, and handle patient follow-ups - all on top of a unified platform for scheduling, payments, memberships, prescriptions, labs, and analytics.

We’re live in **150+ clinics**, processing **$100M+** annually, saving **$7M** in admin time, and generating **$20M+** in new revenue for our customers. We have grown more than ten-fold in the last 6 months.

https://youtu.be/Ala-OpQMy4M

### Problem

Every clinic has knowledge - how patients move through the workflow, which tasks matter most, what providers need, what's already been done, what's still pending.

But that knowledge lives in **ten different tools** and the minds of staff who come and go.

So every day feels like starting from scratch:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96026&key=user_uploads/1279796/be2f277d-ce92-4e4d-91f7-bcca78422717)

This isn't a workflow issue. **It's a missing foundation.**

### **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96026&key=user_uploads/1279796/65d5dc7a-69ef-430c-a89f-5d4376294f1a)

First, we built the **full suite of modules every clinic needs**: scheduling, intake & consent forms, unified communications, charting & documentation, inventory & checkout, patient messaging, and reporting & analytics.

Then we layered on intelligent agents that carry deep context and perform tasks like **answering calls, taking notes, and keeping calendars full.**

Because these agents and modules live inside the same platform, every workflow becomes connected and actionable.

The more a clinic uses Decoda, the **smarter** and **more streamlined** it becomes. This creates a **compounding advantage:** each clinic builds more longitudinal data, each agent becomes smarter with greater context, and each workflow grows increasingly deterministic.

Over time, the system becomes not just a tool, but a **trusted co-pilot for running the clinic**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96026&key=user_uploads/1279796/ee1b49ba-10ab-4e46-9e86-f9d152c5c10f)

### Why Now

**AI gives tiny teams massive leverage.** As a team of <10 people, we’ve already out-shipped incumbents with 500-person orgs. This moment, and our focus on clinic workflows, creates a rare window to build a category-defining platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96026&key=user_uploads/1279796/f3e45a34-b6a8-4599-89bc-0606823b3237)

### Starting with elective care

More people want to live longer, happier, and healthier and are willing to spend on caring for themselves.

We are starting with a focus on **wellness, longevity, anti-aging, medical aesthetics, dermatology,** and **cosmetic surgery practices.**

This segment of care is growing fast and remains underserved by incumbent solutions.

### Ask

If you know someone operating an elective care clinic or any talented folks that want to join us on our mission in any capacity (engineering, sales, ops, etc.), we’d love to hear from you.

✉️ email us at [founders@decodahealth.com](mailto:founders@decodahealth.com)!

💼 share our careers page with your talented friends: [link here.](https://app.dover.com/jobs/decodahealth)

launches.body:
**TLDR** - Fortuna Health is TurboTax for Medicaid. We simplify Medicaid application filing so consumers can easily check eligibility, enroll, and renew their coverage.

**The Problem**

Today, \~90M Americans on Medicaid face acute challenges with eligibility screenings and (re)enrollment. It takes hours for consumers to navigate glitchy websites and long, paper Medicaid forms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73742&key=user_uploads/89898/ebdc0992-91cf-4f63-b15d-9fd3402c314b)

The experience is so poor that procedural reasons (e.g., form errors, missing a notice in the mail) account for a staggering 75% of disenrollments. This is terrible for consumers who lose coverage and produces huge downstream consequences: Medicaid health plans (MCOs) lose over $30B from churn, providers suffer $13B in lost patient revenue and uncompensated care, and states waste $8B on administrative costs.

More than ever before, Medicaid enrollment demands immediate attention given the ongoing Medicaid redetermination crisis putting 15M enrollees at risk of losing coverage in the next 18 months.\
**\
Our Solution**

Fortuna solves the $57B enrollment problem with a consumer product (beautiful, simple state Medicaid filing experience just like Turbotax is for taxes). By making products that consumers want to use, we unlock immense value for providers and health plans.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73742&key=user_uploads/89898/a3771849-1883-4036-8992-88cec6086161)

Our unique approach provides consumers with a seamless web experience, eliminating the need to interact with state portals. We offer 60-second eligibility checks and 5-minute (re)enrollment in 7 languages. To accelerate completing applications, we allow consumers to connect accounts that auto-populate their filings, provide a "virtual" mailbox for state and health plan communications, and send text notifications for urgent actions.

Providers and health plans have had limited real-time visibility into enrollment and revenue risk until now. The Fortuna platform allows providers and health plans to seamlessly monitor Medicaid enrollment status and consumer next steps, receive real-time updates on contact information, and benefit from comprehensive analytics.

Our vision is to transform the enrollment experience and expand our products to become the consumer-facing digital infrastructure that powers the $800B+ Medicaid ecosystem.

**The Team**

We’re all former operators and engineers with experience scaling early and mid-stage healthcare startups that covered Medicaid.

* Cydney is a former management consultant who helped scale a health tech company from seed to Series C as General Manager and VP of Operations and Strategy. 30% of the company’s patients were Medicaid beneficiaries.
* Ben was the first software engineer at behavioral health revenue cycle startup Juniper (YC W21) and helped grow the engineering team to 12. Almost 40% of children in the US are covered under Medicaid/CHIP.
* Nikita started her career at Oscar Health and spent the past 2 years at Truepill (YC S17) building pharmacy solutions for community health centers and FQHCs that served Medicaid patients. She was born on public assistance.

**The Ask**

Know any health plans, hospitals, and provider organizations with large Medicaid populations? Please reach out to [**founders@fortunahealth.com**](mailto:founders@fortunahealth.com)

**TL;DR:** [**Wattson Health**](https://www.wattsonhealth.com/)**’s automation platform integrates with pharmacies' existing systems and enables them to fill prescriptions error-free in a matter of seconds vs. hours or even days.**

### **THE PROBLEM**

Medication errors cost the healthcare industry $40 billion each year, the largest contributor being the manual processes employed by pharmacies. Software development within the pharmacy space has lagged behind other industries. Pharmacies are often saddled with old technology systems that don’t talk to each other. The result is a lot of duct-taped manual solutions in order to fill prescriptions. Entire teams are needed to be hired for data entry and review, costing pharmacies time and money.

### **THE SOLUTION**

[Wattson Health](https://www.wattsonhealth.com/)’s automation platform integrates seamlessly with existing pharmacy software to manage the “prescription lifecycle.”

**Healthcare systems across the world spend $1.1 trillion\* on repetitive processes completed manually by healthcare staff.** [Healthtech-1](https://www.healthtech1.uk/) automates repetitive processes for healthcare systems. We’re starting with the world’s most famous: the NHS. We’re already live in over 100 primary care practices, and we’re hiring.

---

### **Problem**

In Britain, from the moment you first open your eyes, to the moment you finally close them, you’re cared for by the NHS free at the point of delivery _\- it’s a beautiful thing_ 💙

The NHS is a safety net for the most vulnerable people in British society, and Europe’s biggest employer. This year, as the NHS turns 75, **9/10 people agree that healthcare should be free of charge,** and more than 8/10 of agree that the NHS makes them proud to be British.

But at the current rate, the NHS won’t see its 100th birthday. Post-pandemic, Britain's most treasured institution is in crisis. **Patient satisfaction is at a 25-year low and 1/7 of staff are in the process of leaving, citing mental and physical exhaustion.**

Longer lives and an ageing population are steadily increasing the complexity and pressure of providing healthcare. **The increasing demand is unsustainable unless the cost of providing care can be massively reduced.**

The largest single cost is the staff. The NHS pays a $93bn wage bill, for 470k administrators, 740k clinicians, and 50k managers\*\*. All of whom spend an eye-watering amount of time on manual repetitive processes: data entry, summarisation, filing, scheduling..._the list goes on._

The current plan is “hire more staff”, but recruitment isn’t the answer.

### **Solution**

Healthtech-1 uses the latest technology to automate repetitive processes for healthcare organisations. The first automation launched 18 months ago for new patient registrations is now live in over 100 NHS Primary Care practices across England saving over 1000 hours of staff time per week.

So far we’ve added the equivalent of 25 full-time staff to the NHS providing a 9.8/10 ⭐️ experience to patients, for **half the cost.** That’s how you make free healthcare sustainable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73529&key=user_uploads/860223/c5a83841-8d79-42f0-9689-0a48dee0e89e)

Based out of Raj's parents' primary care practice, the Healthtech-1 team is systematically automating the repetitive processes they experience every day.

### **Team**

It started as two school friends, now **we’re a team of 5 engineers, 3 doctors, and an accountant.**

[**@Peter Huang**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/petejayhuang/) is an ex-Monzo software engineer that has built products that millions of people love. [**@Raj Kohli**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajkumarkohli/) is an NHS Clinical Entrepreneur who has delivered intelligent automation for global banks. After starting our first company, we jumped into healthcare to support Raj’s parents during the pandemic.

We’re here at YC to redirect the world’s best talent to one of the world’s greatest opportunities for good: universal healthcare.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73529&key=user_uploads/860223/7d4df318-8951-4d3d-9137-23a006c6d574)

### **Ask**

If you know any operators or engineers interested in making something people need, please intro them to [raj@healthtech1.uk](mailto:raj@healthtech1.uk).

\-

**References:**

_\*$9 trillion spent on healthcare (_[_WHO, 2022_](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240064911)_). Admin spend varies between 10-30% depending on the geography (_[_Health Affairs, 2022)_](https://www.healthaffairs.org/do/10.1377/hpb20220909.830296/)_. Let’s assume 12%._

Veronica and Sophia here, we’re building Harbera. Harbera is AI software that helps healthcare organizations keep their providers - physicians, dentists, nurse practitioners - in-network with insurers and compliant.

<https://youtu.be/75SKmVEMBvs>

## Without credentials doctors can’t treat patients

Credentialing is the bureaucratic process of verifying a providers’ qualifications and contracting them with insurance plans. The 900+ insurance companies across the U.S. have different and ever-changing credentialing requirements, and providers need to be re-credentialed regularly. 

Keeping providers credentialed is critical. If a provider falls out-of-network, it can take months to get credentialed again. Health systems are often unaware that a provider has fallen out-of-network until claims start getting denied, leading to disrupted patient care and billions in lost revenue.

## Monitoring credentialing is hard and gets harder at scale

There’s a lot that administrators need to keep track of: updates to insurance plan requirements (often mailed), license and certification expirations, malpractice sanctions, re-credentialing timelines, and more. Today, many back-office teams at hospitals and clinic groups use spreadsheets, filing cabinets, or even repurpose tools like Salesforce to track credentialing.

Here’s why monitoring is challenging for organizations:

* A telehealth company that accepts 10 insurance plans and works with 100 therapists across 30 states needs to track up to 30,000 statuses.
* A dental group working with 200 dentists needs to track 8,000 statuses. (Dentists are enrolled in over 40 insurance plans on average.)

## What we’re doing

We are making credentialing easy. Our software integrates with a healthcare organization’s existing systems to continuously monitor and proactively re-credential providers across states and insurance plans. We keep administrators in the loop so providers never fall out-of-network. We make onboarding new providers seamless with real-time document validation. We analyze credentialing trends to identify revenue growth opportunities and optimize staffing.

## About us

We’re best friends from college. We studied and taught Computer Science together at Harvard. [Veronica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/veronicanutting/) was a software engineer at Stripe, and [Sophia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophia--clark/) was a software engineer at House Rx, a specialty pharmacy software startup serving clinics across the country.

### **Introducing Paratus – AI-Powered Patient Intake**

**TL;DR**

Patients wait months for an appointment, often with no guidance or symptom tracking in the meantime. When they finally see a doctor, the first 5-10 minutes of the visit are wasted gathering history instead of diagnosing and treating.

**Right now, there are only two ways to handle patient intake:**

* **Static intake forms** – Miss key details, forcing doctors to play catch-up.
* **Triage nurses** – Costly, difficult to scale, and still prone to oversight.

Paratus changes this. Our AI-powered intake assistant gathers symptoms, flags concerns, and delivers a structured clinical summary before the visit even starts—so doctors walk in fully informed.

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/KHh7fp5svY8).

### **It’s Time for a New Wave of AI-Powered Intake**

✅ **Conversational AI engages patients before their visit,** collecting deeper insights than any form ever could.\
✅ **Doctor-approved triage** – Uses **500+ Schmitt-Thompson protocols** and cross-checks medical literature.\
✅ **Instant structured reports** – Doctors walk in fully prepared with:

* Symptom history & differential considerations
* Next steps & testing recommendations
* A pre-visit SOAP note for the EHR
* A full conversation transcript for review

**Think of it as a triage nurse who never misses a detail—at a fraction of the cost.**

### **How It Works**

1. **Instant Patient Connection** – The patient clicks an SMS link and connects with our AI assistant.
2. **Conversational AI Consultation** – Our AI dynamically adapts to responses, uncovering key details just like a triage nurse.
3. **Automated Pre-Visit Reports** – We run the full transcript through our fine-tuned LLM, extracting structured insights for the doctor.

### **The Problem: Long Waits & Inefficient Intake**

* **Months-long wait times** leave patients in limbo with no support.
* **Doctors start visits blind**, leading to rushed decisions and missed symptoms.
* **Triage nurses are expensive and inefficient**, yet essential for collecting high-quality data.

Paratus solves these problems, ensuring patients feel heard before their visit and doctors can focus on diagnosis, not data collection.

### **What Patients Are Saying**

_"I called as a mother for my son’s ear pain. I was impressed by the AI’s clarity, empathy, and ability to ask the right questions. Honestly, it was better to talk to than a real nurse!"_

### **Why Us?**

Best friends Tannen Hall and Pablo Bermudez-Canete, both AI students from Stanford, founded Paratus Health to fix a problem they experienced firsthand—the broken patient intake process.

For 11 years, Tannen watched his family members - and himself - grow sicker without a diagnosis for a rare disease. They endured months-long waits for every appointment, only to leave with more questions than answers. Each new doctor started from scratch, missing critical details that could have led to the right diagnosis sooner. By the time they finally got answers, it was too late to undo the damage.

That experience left Tannen frustrated with a system that forces patients to wait in limbo while their health deteriorates. He wrote about this problem in his Stanford application, and today, there is no one more determined to fix it.

Now, he and Pablo are building Paratus, an AI-powered intake platform that ensures no patient is left waiting without support and no doctor walks in unprepared.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87836&key=user_uploads/1786718/3a9b560c-8f62-4376-9297-67a19ff14f04)

### **Our Vision**

A world where doctors walk in ready to diagnose, not gather symptoms- because every patient’s full story is already in their hands.

## **TL;DR**

Pelica is the AI operating system for value-based care. We pull claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and hospital feeds into **one canonical record**, then run AI copilots that read and write to it: risk adjustment, Stars and quality, pharmacy, provider network, and care management, plus an AI data analyst you can ask anything in plain English. The copilots **do the operational work themselves**: capturing HCCs in real time, closing gaps once across every payer, and making outreach calls in the member’s language. HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and RADV-defensible.

We’re live with a physician-led IPA in New York, one of the largest independent medical groups in the Northeast: **2,500+ hours saved** and higher CMS Star Ratings so far.

▶️ Watch their story: <https://youtu.be/2CGmyif9Yd4>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/e873acc4-f206-4eca-8617-9bf7f70f3b62)

_An AI agent works one gap end to end: provider office, pharmacy, the member in their language, the payer portal, then a live call. Closed in 3 minutes of staff time._

## **🚩 The problem**

Value-based care pays a medical group or health plan to keep a whole population healthy, and billions in CMS bonuses ride on it. The teams who own those contracts decide whether the org makes money, and they cannot operate:

• Their data lives in 8 to 15 systems. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.

• Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again, sometimes in a language the member doesn’t speak.

• The best predictive model is worthless if it never reaches the provider.

• The rules keep moving. Hybrid HEDIS is retiring into ECDS volumes many times higher per measure, and the V28 phase-in costs the average MA plan about 3% of RAF.

Every new gap gets a new point vendor, each with its own portal, data model, and login. These teams do not need another point tool. They need an operating system.

## **🛠️ What we built**

One canonical record, with an AI workforce next to every team. Six copilots:

• **Risk Adjustment:** real-time HCC capture with trumping logic and RADV-defensible chain of custody on every code.

• **Quality and Stars:** gap closure unified across every payer, with year-round forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.

• **Pharmacy and Part D:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars the most.

• **Provider Network:** auto-built practice agendas that cut meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.

• **Care Management:** ADT-driven transitions-of-care worklists, with no duplicate calls across teams.

• **AI Data Analyst:** plain-English questions against the record, in place of the BI ticket queue.

_AI Data Analyst: ask your RAF in plain English, get an answer and a chart in seconds._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/4bbf9afb-abc0-4221-9e5b-bf4602654e32)

_Provider Network: reps walk in prepped, and the visit is captured into tasks automatically._

It runs on the systems VBC teams already use: Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, and labs, with SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena. A new source onboards in days, and the copilots start working the day after.

## **📈 Early proof**

That physician-led IPA went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach, in the right language, that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount. One of their leaders put it simply: “You don’t just get software, you get partners.”

## **👫 Why us**

Catherine and I met at YouTube and have built large-scale systems together since. We saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations software that could not reason clinically.

• **Catherine** led AI work on Gemini and enterprise agents at Google, did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine, and saw front-line care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

• **Lalit** spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube, most recently as engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-person team on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA, ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

Hi YC! We’re Jonathan, Anton, and James - and we’re building **Phases**.

**We’re already live with customers,** helping them fill trials faster, hit recruitment targets, and prevent costly delays, without adding any additional work to research teams.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=10N_b2s4128

## ❌ The Problem

**75% of people die from diseases we still can't cure (WHO).**

Clinical trials are how we bring new treatments to the world, but today it takes over a decade and more than $1 billion to bring a new drug to market. Nowhere is the problem more obvious than in **patient recruitment.**

Recruitment is the biggest bottleneck:

* **Research sites** read 1000s of medical records and run 30+ min screening calls to enroll just 1 in 10 patients, using phones, spreadsheets, and disconnected systems.
* **Patients:** Wait days or weeks to hear back, face slow and frustrating screening processes, and often drop out due to poor communication and lost trust.
* **Pharma companies:** Lose up to $312M per delayed trial (12.2-month average delay), with 80% of studies missing recruitment targets despite spending 30% of their budgets on it.

## 👷 The Solution

Meet **Polly** - the AI recruiter for clinical trials.

Polly is an AI agent that helps research sites find, interview, and schedule patients for clinical trials. She integrates with the tools the team already uses, so there’s nothing new to learn.

Polly handles recruitment end-to-end, with potentially eligible patients automatically landing in research site calendars for their first visit.

**How Polly helps:**

* **Speed:** Saves team's hours per week by automating medical records reviews and turning 30+ minute screening conversations into 1-minute decisions.
* **Scale & Flexibility:** Engages every patient the moment they express interest, 24/7, and scales on-demand, handling thousands of conversations at once without burdening research teams.
* **Cost:** Automates the most labor-intensive parts of patient recruitment, filling trials faster at a fraction of the cost.

## 🚀 The Vision

Polly is just the start. We’re building the digital workforce for clinical research that will run all back-office trial operations so research teams can focus on patients, not paperwork.

For anyone living with or caring for someone with a chronic condition, one thing is clear: **Developing life-saving drugs shouldn't take a decade.**

## 👋 Our Backstory

Our founding team worked on integrating machine learning into the mobile ads app at Meta, developer and deployment experiences at Palantir, and published deep learning research in microsurgical robotics at the University of Toronto. Our CEO, who grew up around clinical trials with a mother overseeing dozens of studies as medical director at J&J, Janssen, and Schering Plough, has designed data science AI agents adopted by leading companies, including J&J and Syneos Health.

\
Reclaim solves this by

1. Reading tens of thousands of pages of charts every night
2. Finding issues that can lead to insurance denials or other issues

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Our mission is personal. Each of us watched someone we love slip through the cracks of today’s healthcare system. Peter’s grandfather suffered three preventable ER readmissions before passing—his ruptured aorta went undetected after missed medications and a complete absence of follow-up care. Lukas’s grandmother, who raised him, deteriorated in assisted living—isolated, depressed, and unrecognizable before passing unexpectedly just days before he arrived. Kazuki’s grandfather battled cancer alone in Japan, cut off from family by COVID-era hospital restrictions—reminding us that healing requires more than medicine.

What we experienced is not rare. It’s the reality for tens of millions of older adults. In ERs, nursing homes, and senior communities where we’ve volunteered, we saw the same  patterns: chronic conditions unmanaged, dangerous falls ignored, weeks without human connection, and emergencies that could have been prevented. Aging has become a quiet crisis—fueled by staff shortages, fragmented systems, lack of technology access, and stigma about growing old. 

We’ve invested 600+ hours on the ground working with older adults to deeply understand their’ needs, motivations, and barriers. Our team brings full-stack software, AI/ML, and hardware expertise from Neuralink, Stanford, and NVIDIA, along with operating experience leading major organizations like Zero2One (largest startup group at UIUC), Stanford Founders (1,500+ members), and Covalence (2,000 volunteers across seven universities)—this gives us the tools needed to lead transformation in this space. 

We’re here because we believe older adults deserve independence, dignity, and a healthcare system that truly cares—and we’re building Kaigo Health to make that the new standard.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our vision is to transform healthcare into a continuous, preventative, and home-based experience. We start by enabling high touch outpatient care for Medicare providers, supercharging value-based care. This builds consumer trust and a proprietary data layer, and leverages existing provider distribution networks to later phase in more advanced ambient sensing and care delivery technologies (e.g. home robot companions) for 24/7 personal health management - bringing healthcare to the home while hospitals focus on acute care.

launches.body:
Hey YC!

I'm Christine Park, founder of Lattice Health. We make sure the AI that hospitals deploy on medical imaging keeps working after it goes live.

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/p0l029tsmhs>

Website: <https://www.latticehealthai.com/>

**The problem.** Hospitals are adopting medical imaging AI faster than ever. But once a model is live, almost no one can answer a basic question: is it still working? Models drift, a scanner upgrade or a shift in the patient population can quietly degrade accuracy, and performance often varies across patient groups. Most of that goes unseen today, and it's the hospital, not the vendor, that carries the risk.

**What we built.** Lattice is a monitoring and governance layer for deployed imaging AI. We plug in beside the imaging pipeline as a read-only observer and continuously check each model: how well it agrees with the radiologist's read, whether it's drifting over time, and how it performs across patient subgroups. Then we turn that into the evidence hospitals need for safety, governance, and compliance. Lattice never touches patient care, it only watches, so if Lattice stops, care continues.

**Why now.** AI is moving into clinical use under a wave of new expectations from the FDA, ONC, and the ACR, and they all point to the same gap: continuous post-deployment monitoring. Hospitals are on the hook for it and have almost no tooling to do it.

**Our ask.** We'd love intros to health system and radiology leaders, CMIOs, and anyone running AI governance at a hospital, as well as imaging AI vendors who want their models monitored well in the field. And if you have thoughts or hard questions, drop them in the comments or email me at [christine@latticehealthai.com](mailto:christine@latticehealthai.com)

Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team.

The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production.

A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption.

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re Max Shand and Campbell Mercer, co-founders of Avoca Systems.

TL;DR: Avoca automates patient scheduling and communications for radiology groups. Our radiology-specific AI handles calls, online scheduling, faxes and e-referrals, guiding patients from referral and booking through to results and follow-up. We’re already live across more than 250 clinics, including networks operating 150+ locations.

<https://youtu.be/ZU3Ebvs5Mk0>

**What it does**

Radiology scheduling is unusually complex. A valid appointment can depend on the modality, body region, contrast requirements, patient history, preparation instructions, equipment availability, staff qualifications and referring-provider details.

These rules are fragmented across legacy systems, spreadsheets and the tacit knowledge of experienced receptionists. Generic voice and scheduling tools struggle to bring them together.

Avoca integrates with a radiology network’s existing systems and turns its workflows and operational knowledge into one automation layer:

* **AI calls:** Answers inbound calls and runs outbound campaigns for bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, preparation questions and general enquiries.
* **Online scheduling:** Lets patients upload their referral, complete the necessary clinical and safety questions, and find an appropriate appointment in real time.
* **Fax and e-referral automation:** Ingests and interprets referrals, identifies missing information and contacts patients to complete their booking.
* **Operational intelligence:** Encodes each network’s booking rules, rosters, staff capabilities, preferences and tacit knowledge so Avoca can safely fill available scanner capacity.
* **Patient communications:** Guides patients through preparation, intake, reminders, results and follow-up using voice, text and email.

**Why this matters**

Up to 30% of calls into radiology centres go unanswered as patients wait on hold. Referrals arrive through phones, websites, faxes and electronic systems, leaving staff to manually interpret documents, contact patients and coordinate appointments across multiple systems.

At the same time, radiology providers face staff shortages, rising operating costs and reimbursement pressure. Missed calls and unprocessed referrals mean patients wait longer while valuable scanner capacity goes unfilled.

Avoca helps networks capture more patient demand, reduce administrative work and complete more scans using their existing clinics, equipment and clinical systems.

**Traction**

* Partnered with 250+ clinics, including several of Australia’s largest radiology networks
* Reduced call abandonment from approximately 30% to 2%
* Patient satisfaction averaging 4.6/5
* More than 80% booking conversion for eligible patient calls in major deployments
* Integrated with leading radiology and healthcare systems, including Visage, Karisma, Comrad, Epic, Oracle Health and eClinicalWorks
* Now expanding into the United States

**Why we’re building this**

I (Max) was the first employee at Afterpay and later founded and sold Serenade. Cam was previously a principal engineer at Honey Insurance and Macquarie. Across those experiences, we saw how much better an industry can operate when complex workflows are turned into simple, intuitive products.

Healthcare is a chaotic mess of work that falls between systems: calls that go unanswered, referrals that sit in fax queues and operational knowledge that exists only in the heads of experienced staff.

We started with radiology because the scheduling complexity is exceptionally high and the consolidation of radiology clinics into large groups allowed us to focus our GTM efforts on just a few influential stakeholders who acutely feel the pain we’re solving for.

**Our big** **ask**

* Any introduction to a radiology network or health system chief executive (CEO, CIO, COO, CDO, CRO - even the new brand of CAIO - Chief AI Officer) would be hugely appreciated. We’re new to the US and eager to meet leaders tackling the patient access and scheduling challenges we’re solving.

Finally, if you operate a radiology network - or know someone who does - we’d love to hear from you. Please reply here or reach us at [hello@avocasystems.com](mailto:hello@avocasystems.com).
